verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mailbox, or non-production mode where an agent can safely exercise Zero's MCP actions (send, delete, bulk delete). The MCP authenticates with a live browser session cookie against real mailboxes. Self-hosting and the local contributor dev setup (pnpm go, devcontainer, Drizzle Studio) are adjacent developer arrangements, not a product-provided sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
